entities.summary: Michael Timm was a German amateur boxer. He is best known for winning the gold medal at the 1985 European Championships in Budapest, Hungary in the Men's Light Middleweight division. Timm was born in Hagenow, Bezirk Schwerin, East Germany on 13 November 1962.
